From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Quentin Sato <quentin.sato@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Initial phone screen availability — concise grid proposal

Hi Quentin —

Thanks for your interest in the Software Engineer role. I'd love to set up a quick 20-minute phone screen to learn about your background and walk through the role. You're welcome to pick any slot from the short alternating grid below — I put times in both PDT (my side) and CEST (if you're local to Europe). If you're traveling, tell me which day you're on the move and I can bend the times.

Alternating 20-min grid (choose one):
- Tue Jun 22 — 08:30 PDT / 17:30 CEST
- Tue Jun 22 — 11:00 PDT / 20:00 CEST
- Wed Jun 23 — 07:50 PDT / 16:50 CEST
- Wed Jun 23 — 10:20 PDT / 19:20 CEST

If none of these work, send three 20-min windows that do and I'll match with Evelyn (our hiring manager) for availability.

I attached an .ics you can add directly and I've attached the role rubric so the interview stays focused.

Quick asks:
- Preferred phone number?
- Do you prefer Zoom or a phone call?

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: initial_screen.ics (invite stub), phone_screen_rubric.pdf (internal rubric), quentin_sato_resume.pdf (requested earlier)

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. I'm in Prague (CEST) this week but traveling on Wed afternoon to Berlin and will have intermittent signal. I can do the Tue Jun 22 20:00 CEST slot (your 11:00 PDT) — that's ideal.

Phone: +420 606 123 987
Prefer Zoom if possible — easier when I'm moving.

If Evelyn needs an earlier slot, I could also do Tue Jun 22 17:30 CEST (08:30 PDT) but Tue evening is best. I've attached my resume again in case you want to forward.

Looking forward to it —
Quentin
